run_embeddingbag_benchmark: run a pytorch EmbeddingBag performance benchmark on cpu, gpu, or tpu devices via argparse cli
create_XlaEmbeddingBag: create an XLA-compatible EmbeddingBag module that performs sum reduction on sparse index groups
measure_cpu_performance: measure pytorch EmbeddingBag inference time on CPU with configurable warmup and step iterations
measure_gpu_performance: measure pytorch EmbeddingBag inference time on GPU with CUDA synchronization and warmup steps
init_indices_zipf: init random sparse indices using uniform or Zipf distribution for EmbeddingBag benchmarking
